balls.text: hit to extra cover again, and this time is just a single
Kumble misfields at extra cover, allows two when it should have been one
wide! looks to outsmart Agarkar who is backing away, but bowls this wide yorker too far away from the off stump
makes room and cuts a shortish delivery for one
this one nips back in, gets the inside edge, and Uthappa holds onto a low catch to his left
beaten outside off, shortish ball holding its line, they don't want a suicidal bye this time
slower bouncer, is beaten, Agarkar wants to come on strike himself now, and wants the suicidal bye, but Uthappa hits direct even before they have crossed, and Dinda has to go back
beats him with a yorker, Agarkar wants Pujara on strike for the next over and hence goes for a suicidal bye, Pujara is not thinking that far ahead and is very slow coming for the run, and is run out
lovely shot Pujara, makes room this time, and Kallis gives him the length to get under and Pujara lofts him clean and straight over his head
first length ball at manageable pace in a long time, and Pujara gets stuck into it, lofting it over wide long-on
backs away and drives through the covers, wants two but is rightly sent back by Pujara
low full toss on the leg stump, gets a single off the inside half of the bat
bowls a full toss to begin with, hit to deep point for one
he backs away again, Steyn follows him up with a yorker, only a single to mid-on ensues
How did that miss the off stump? Agarkar is backing away, which is not surprising, and he bowls full and fast, 154.1kph, and it beats the off stump by an inch or two
full and fast again, 152.9kph, driven to sweeper-cover
155.1kph, misses his line down the leg side, good save by Uthappa
Steyn is bowling like a champion! After hitting consistent 150-plus speeds, he bowls this slower ball at 107.9kph, and the toe-end is collected easily by long-on
153.1kph, nearly a yorker, clipped away for one
149.5kph, past Pujara before the bat comes down
gives him the charge, Kumble fires it in full and fast, yorking him, another dot ball - what a spell, four overs for 17 runs and a wicket - the overall rate is 8 an over. Jumbo you beauty
full delivery, nicely clipped away for one
googly, gets an inside edge that gets them a single
Big Man gets the Big Wicket! McCullum manufactures a pull shot off a quick (99.6kph) short-of-a-length delivery and he ends up pulling it straight to deep square leg. And Kumble is pumped
shorter, quicker, limp pull down the ground for one
flighted, driven inside-out, finds the Bear at extra cover
154kph, Steyn is fired up, Saha manages to play it to mid-off for one
so you bowl a 149.2kph bouncer, beat the batsman for the pace, and the top edge flies into the first tier! Sorry bowler
too quick, 149.2kph, climbing into the ribs, no choice but to offer a defensive shot
shorter, closer to the stumps, played on the bounce to point
this time he gets closer to the line of the ball, and plays it to wide of sweeper-cover
full outswinger at 147kph, too good for Saha
flat, quick, no room, defended towards midwicket
slower, on the pads, worked away for one
big lbw shout, quicker, straighter ball, through him, but sliding down
flighted generously, driven nicely inside out, but there's a Bear at extra cover. White puts the dive in, saves at least one run
short ball, pulled to deep square leg
worked from in front of the stumps for a single

what a dive to get in! hit just to the right of third man, comes back for two, which is clearly not on, and then almost flies through the last four yards or so. There is more drama! While his bat lands in before the stumps are disturbed, it goes aerial as the bails come off. Benefit of the doubt lets McCullum stay in.
"I'd be spitting blood if I were the bowler," says Robin Jackman! Edged? Guided? The bat face opens and also it takes the edge, and it's gone for four past the keeper
what bat speed, he just swings across the line, is hit on the back of the bat, and it flies over third man for six. Remember the first match of the first IPL, anybody? Edges flying for sixes
Baz keeps KKR in, plays an instinctive upper-cut to a short delivery, and it lands wide of third man and for four
back of a length, just outside off, blocked off the front foot
Bouncerrrr! Bouncer is the word! This one is of the slower variety and Mathews, looking to cut it over point, ends up holing out to sweeper-cover
136kph only, but it nips in and hurries McCullum into a defensive shot
slower ball outside off, helped away to backward point
another bouncer, 138kph, Mathews in better position than Tiwary and manages to keep the pull down
steered down to third man for one
what a bouncer! 140kph, tailing him, throat high. And Tiwary is late into the hook, so late he ends up lobbing it to backward point. Kallis has perhaps one of the meanest bouncers in the world today
just back of a length, just outside off, Tiwary stays back and blocks
back of a length, just outside off, defended back to the bowler
slower ball, into the hip/ribs area, Ganguly is cramped again, and ends up lobbing to Kumble at square leg, who takes quick four strides and uses his long arms of law to good effect
good bouncer, head high, Ganguly pulls out of the pull at the last moment
and Baz tries his scoop again, and has nearly scooped it from outside off onto the stumps as he is tumbling over. What a guy. Gets a single to fine leg
slight straightening of the line upon pitching just outside off, defended back to him
angled across, helped away to third man for one
flat, fast offbreak, defends - big over, for 18
chinaman this time, and he has swept this fine, lovely shot, with the spin, and he has swept KKR back into the lead
swept away over short fine, and it spins away off the second bounce, and viciously, and PK is not prepared for it
sweeps from right in front of stumps, to short fine
offbreak this time, too short, and Baz has pulled this for six. Even Superman Taylor can't get his hand to it
full delivery, stays deep in the crease and sweeps it powerfully behind square for four
googly, pitches outside leg, turns away and hurries him, and he can't even get the leg-bye - only one off the over
another charge at him, he manages to get this to backward point for a single
shorter, flatter, Baz cuts, Kohli at cover-point is onto it in a flash and Ganguly sends him back
charges down, Kumble bowls a low full toss, which is hit straight to extra cover
fails to make contact as he tries to sweep, sliding down, hence no leg-before decision
flighted around off, defended

Roscoe has saved five runs at the deep square leg boundary! one chinaman too many, McCullum is expecting it and pulls it, but Taylor, at the edge of the boundary, jumps full length in the air and almost slam-dunks it back into the field of play
another chinaman, cut away to sweeper-cover
another chinaman, turns in to McCullum, who is cramped on the cut
gets a false forward movement out of Ganguly, Sriram bowls a chinaman - that's news - and Ganguly has to go back and play it to sweeper-cover
flat delivery outside off, pushed to cover
full ball, on the pads, pushed for one
sharp bouncer, 138kph, and McCullum, who is charging down, is too late into the shot
and another steer for a single
another dab to third man for a single
makes room and steers this one down to third man
slower ball, and he stays in the crease and works this for a single
McCullum tries that audacious scoop he tortured Australia with in the Christchurch T20. But is beaten, no contact this time
the flatter, quicker one, worked away for one to on
the loopy wrong'un, McCullum doesn't read it but reacts well when he sees it turn in, defending to leg
lack of spin beats Uthappa this time, pitched up on leg stump line and then keeps on going further - five wides
googly, beats him on the lap sweep, but is pitched outside leg
Kumble 2, Ganguly 1! Deft. Delicate. This one is slightly short, and he opens the face at the latest possible moment, past short third
beats him again with the straighter delivery
nicely bowled, straighter one, Ganguly pokes inside the line
no room this time, but Ganguly drops and runs to cover
lovely shot, he finally connects with that upper-cut upon backing away, gets enough room this time and he smashes a camera outside the point boundary
gives him the charge, Kallis tucks him up, Baz runs it down to third man for a single
stands his ground here, Kallis bowls full and straight, Baz gets an inside edge onto the pad
gives Kallis the dummy walk down the pitch, makes him bowl the bouncer, and it slides down the leg side, it is called wide and Kallis is not pleased with the call

Orange Cap gets the big wicket! full ball, slightly short of yorker, Gayle looks to kill it over extra cover, but because it is too full he can't quite get the elevation, and Dravid holds on to the big catch
gets a thick outside edge for a single as he backs away again
and now the one-handed four, stays back to a slower ball down the leg side, and just slaps it one-handed over short fine
Chris. Gayle. Is. Lovin'. It comes down the track, makes room, and bludgeons it over long-on for a flat six
just stays deep in the crease with his bat held in the air, and turns this back-of-a-length delivery into a pullable length and pull he does over midwicket
makes room again, PK cramps him up again with the shorter one, and this mis-hit gets him a single
can't keep him down for long, the first slower ball tried, and Ganguly picks it early, stays his ground, clears the front leg, and lofts it over long-off - easy does it
Ganguly looking to make room again, PK looking to cramp him again, and PK succeeds with the bouncer, which is hit to mid-on
pulls in front of square this time, and gets it wide of mid-on, Gayle is keeping them going
151kph, and Gayle loves it, he has absolutely hammered it wide of mid-off, powerful, what timing, and it was back of a length mind you
tucks him up with a short one, Ganguly tips and runs a single
looks to clear his front leg and heave it over the leg side, and Steyn is too quick and straight for that shot here

full ball, hit to Kallis in Orange Cap at point, two steps down the pitch, comes back, Kallis tries to sneak in a run-out, and Ganguly has only just come back in the crease - and he wasn't even trying the single. Top fielding so far
Ganguly backs away again, and misses a full delivery just outside off
again PK ends a good over with a short ball and again he is punished, pulled away for four this time
this time Gayle stays back, PK slips it down the leg side, and gets Uthappa on the wrist
cramps him again, with a short one down the leg side, Ganguly manages a single
Gayle charges down the track and smashes it back at him, PK gets a hand on it, saving three runs
Ganguly not looking comfortable so far, backs away again, PK follows him with a short one, and he lobs it to deep square leg on the bounce
beauty, follows the outswinger with a big inswinger, and it takes the outside edge that flies wide of slip for a single
big outswinger, beats Gayle, missing leg
backs away to look to go over point, but is beaten by the extra bounce
looks to tuck him up with a back-of-a-length delivery, Sourav stays back and blocks
what a save by Vinay at mid-off! This was murdered wide of him, at some pace, and he dived full length to save three runs. Top stuff
full and wide, and now Gayle can use the pace of Steyn, and he hits it over point, and third man can take only two steps before it hits the boundary boards
that's a ripper, 145.4kph, back of a length, extra bounce, slight movement away, and beats him
144.5kph, looked like it would swing in towards Gayle, who plays for that movement, but it moves away upon pitching, and beats him
the last ball, the extra ball after that wide, is short, and Ganguly gives himself room and cuts it past point for four
back to bowling inswing, but too straight, Gayle gets a single to square leg
outswinger this time, moves in too much down the leg side
and straightaway ends up angling one down the leg side, and it straightens only a touch, Ganguly takes a single to mid-on
makes him go for the adventurous shot with those two first deliveries, Ganguly makes room to slash over cover but misses
another big inswinger, Ganguly's feet are stuck, and he is beaten
swing first away, inswing, pitching leg and moving towards off, blocked by Ganguly
and Taylor finishes it off by depositing a full toss into the square-leg boundary
oh dear, another reverse sweep, this is hit even better, and it is a bigger six over cover-point, fifty up off 22 balls, and scores level
powerful sweep to deep midwicket, and there is a fielder there but he can't stop it even though it is not hit too far off him
regulation sweep, misses this one

reverse-swept for six or is it? lovely timing to get it to deep point, but it's actually a drop! Ishant ran in too far and then sees it lob him, and then kicks an IPL board in disgust. There will be hell to pay for that, buddy! Get ready for fines
swept along the ground this time, there is yes and no about the second, but a misfield in the deep has them safe
Taylor has seen enough of Mendis, and now he sweeps him for a six, gets under this carrom ball, and that amazing bat speed does the rest
slower ball, Uthappa wants to send it to Cubbon Park but is through with the shot early
good delivery, back of a length, extra bounce beats Uthappa's attempt at running it past the keeper
bouncer, too high
slower ball, Robin mis-hits, but the top edge falls safe at deep square leg
another half-volley, this time Robin gets a thick outside edge over short third
I can smell an early finish, half-volley this time, and he has played it inside-out, wide of long-off
and is despatched over long-off first ball. Length ball, outside off, flat-batted straight down the ground
guides this to short third and retains strike
throws it up wide, gives him the room to swing his arms, and swing he does, an open-chested, flat-batted sweep, over his head
carrom ball, outside off, Taylor bunts it for one
Robin cross-bats this length ball on the first bounce to the very fielder moved in the deep
carrom ball, looks for the big sweep, gets a big inside edge onto the pad
flighted googly, turned around the corner for one
flat six, shuffles across, gets a length ball, and swats it over midwicket
tucks him up with one aimed for the ribs, Taylor drops and runs
driven down to long-on for one
back of a length, moves too far across, and has to defend it back to the bowler
gone! Done in by the slower ball, wants to go over extra cover, but he ends up hitting straight to sweeper-cover. Agarkar takes the catch this time. Superb innings nonetheless
clipped away of the hips for a single
across the line, but Robin usually connects those, this is mis-hit, one bounce to midwicket for one
doesn't get enough on this drive, only a single to extra cover
R.A.H.U.L inside-out, flat, over cover fielder, just high enough to beat Hussey, one of the best fielders in this IPl. What's more, fifty up too
Dravid! Clears front leg, gets under a length delivery, and goes sweetly over long-on
gets inside the line, and flicks it to fine leg for one
cut in front of square, gets a single to extra cover
lovely timing, lovely stop at deep midwicket, just met it with an angled bat, and Tiwary had to take four quick steps and a tumble to save this from going to the boundary
Dinda is charged up, gets it to hold its line outside off, Robin pokes at it and is beaten
gone! timber! Sriram, striking at less than 100 per 100 balls, had to either hit out or get out! He gets out, looking for the big shot over mid-off, and playing on
good bouncer, beats him for the pace again
138.4kph, beaten for pace as he goes for the square cut
short ball, follows Dravid, off the splice, gets him a single
angled into the pads, flicked away for one - quiet over, just four off
sees the googly early, comes down the track, and drives it to long-on
another carrom ball, pushed down to long-on for one
quick carrom ball, hit back to the bowler
googly, picks it up early, and sweeps it square for one
carrom ball, pulled wide of long-on, and calls for two early, Hussey goes for Sriram's end and he puts in the dive
length ball, goes for the big hit, mis-hits but manages a single to long-off
looks to cut but it is too close to the stumps, and he is beaten
slower ball, half-volley, and Sriram drives it inside-out, past extra cover. It's called rubbing vinegar into a wound
nips in sharp, gets an inside edge onto the thigh pad for one
back of a length, hit to extra cover
dropped by Agarkar at deep square leg, poor delivery, short, sitting up, and Sriram has pulled it straight to Ajit, and it goes in and comes out
this time it is too full, and is flicked away for one
googly again, hit to straightish extra cover

two-fingered googly, nicely flighted outside off, Sriram is surprised by the slowness and is beaten outside off. Extra bounce means Saha takes an extra second to whip the bails off, and Sriram is back in by then
corrom ball, Sriram looks to scoop it, blind-sighting Saha, and what should have been one wide becomes five
shortish ball, pulled straight down to long-on
carrom ball, on the pads, worked away for one
slog-sweeps first ball, gets inside edge onto the pad
short and wide, gets a single to the sweeper
square-drive, lovely shot, but now they have deep point in place
slower ball, bunted for one towards point, Dravid makes it despite Tiwary's Jonty-like work to hit the stumps direct
back of a length, outside off, steered to third man
short and wide, and you know what's the drill
Dravid premeditates a pull, it is not quite short enough, but he manages two off the mis-timed pull
slower ball, whipped away to deep square leg for a single
short and wide, no feet in the cut shot, and plays away from the body, and gets a single to sweeper-cover
length ball, takes a single to mid-off
beauty! ripper! back of a length, just outside off, holding its line, beats Dravid
into the pads, hit straight to midwicket, two dots in a row
short and wide and nips away to beat the square cut
that one spits at him, and played like Dravid does in the Tests, leaning away, getting the bottom hand of the handle, and running it down to third man for one
slower ball, 96kph, sees it and plays a delicious straight drive, and there is no stopping this shot
whipped away from outside off, hit wide of deep square and comes back for two
short and wide, and I tell you what, he has cut it straight into the ground, and it reaches the fence on the third bounce
back of a length, holds its line outside off, hit to cover
Delicate. Deft. After having sent Gayle off with a powerful hit! Waits for this length ball, and shows it the open face and guides it past the keeper
nips back in, gets an inside edge onto the pad, concedes a single
pulled away, he has broken through Gayle's hands it seems, powerfully hit, Gayle at midwicket gets a left hand to it, the ball still flies by, and Gayle is holding onto his thumb
short and wide, mis-times the cut shot, gets a single to cover
slower short ball, and it's wide, and Sriram reaches for it, and gets it over point, enough bat behind it to get four
whipped away to deep square leg for a single
Dravid looks to pull, but this is too full for the shot
half-volley on off stump, crashed past mid-off, first boundary of the innings - overall, a good start for Kolkata so far
short, is cramped up on the cut, gets just a single to point
backs away, is cramped, manages a limp pull to square leg
back of a length outside off, hit to wide of mid-on
short ball, nice pace, extra bounce, top-edged, but it lands safely, wide of deep square leg
KKR are all up for it tonight. This time Saha makes a full-length diving save to his right and saves three runs
swings and misses outside off
Dinda is fired up, dives full length in his follow through even though the ball is far off him. No single ensues
they have got him! The big wicket! Almost dropped! Kallis goes for the big square drive, gets a thick edge, which almost pops out of Gayle's hands at slip, but he recovers and holds onto the rebound
lovely attempt by Pujara at the cover boundary! Starts with a lovely inside-out shot, but Pujara dives full length to nearly take a spectacular catch
short and wide, cut away, gets a single to third man
Sriram backs away, slashes and misses
driven with an open face, gets a single to third man
misfield by Ishant in his follow through, Kallis gets the single to keep the strike
fuller, outside off, 138.3kph, left alone
whips this away off the hips for a single to square leg
beauty, back of a length, nipping away, extra bounce, beats Sriram, Saha collects it head high
short, 140.1kph, late into the attempted pull
back of a length, outside off, drop and run for Kallis
just a shimmy down the pitch, he cramps him up, but Kallis manages to cut it past gully
dropped by Ganguly at mid-off, strong inside-out strike from Kallis and the overhead catch goes through Ganguly's fingers
short and wide, but slower, 130.7kph, hence he doesn't get the timing right, and ends up playing it to cover-point
140kph, back of a length, around off, patted back to him
swing there, full and wide, and easily left alone
tucks him up with a short ball into the ribs, manages one off the body
